about: Surf's Up! Surf School has taught on Polzeath beach since 1995 and welcomes all ages and abilities. It runs beginner, improver and intermediate lessons as groups or privately, plus school and club trips, a local kids' after-school club and residential courses. It also lets out a self-catering beach house in Polzeath.
offers: Beginner, improver and intermediate group lessons
goodToKnow: Group sizes follow Surfing England's recommended ratios
Surfing England Centre of Excellence; instructors are qualified beach lifeguards
